name: Step Through Shadows (Sp)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Unchained Ninja Master Tricks
body:
Prerequisite: Master tricks

Benefit: A ninja who selects this trick can disappear into an area of dim light or darkness and emerge from another area of dim light or darkness. This functions as shadow step. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.
